events.title: Demo Update (0.1.0.0), 18th October 2026
events.summary: Tonight I've put together what will probably be the last update prior to NextFest (which is less than 20 hours away now, ahhhhhhhh....) This update adds some new display settings, improves the UI around Encyclopedia unlockables and adds sound effects to the Mining Tools.Improvement: More resolution options and fullscreen modeThe games settings now have a much fuller set of resolution options as well as the option to select Windowed or Fullscreen. Fullscreen will just use your monitors native res

events.title: Demo Update (0.0.3.1), 5th October 2026
events.summary: Yesterday I launched a small update to add a new feature to the encyclopedia and the asteroid chunks.Feature: Unlocked Encyclopedia entries will now grant a production/output bonus for the mining tool they relate toEncyclopedia entries will now indicate that they provide an X% bonus to production/output to a given mining tool once unlocked. events.title: Demo update (0.0.2), 23rd September 2026
events.summary: Tonight we've released a short patch to resolve a couple of issues.Bug: Unlocking Tier 4 causes the game to crash (many thanks to the player who reported this issue in the game forum!)

events.title: Idle Mining Manager Demo is now Live
events.summary: The Demo is now Live!You can now try out the first few tiers of content in the Idle Mining Manager Demo, which includes access to all the main gameplay systems. I expect the demo will have at least 30 minutes of content leading up to the unlocking of Tier 3 (the current end point for the demo).
